name: true-release-soul-core-lv2
about: True Release (= Super Unleash; Standard rule manual 'True Release', CR 12-2-1-1): Gen-Bor (26RSD01-002, LV1 1 core / LV2 3 cores, '[LV2] (True Release) (During Attack) This Spirit gains +2000 BP.') holding only the Soul Core is LV2 (5000 BP) and gains +2000 BP while it attacks; Monocowl (26RSD10-004) with one normal core stays LV1.
